title: CPT Invariance Axiom
interpretation: Asserts that the combined operation of Charge Conjugation (C), Parity (P), and Time Reversal (T) is an absolute symmetry of any local, relativistic quantum field theory.
symmetry_origin: The fundamental requirements of Lorentz invariance, locality, and the positive-energy condition in the subatomic manifold.
limits_and_boundary: Ensures that a violation of T-symmetry must be identically balanced by a violation of CP-symmetry to preserve the structural integrity of the vacuum.

title: T-Violation Asymmetry (A_T)
equation: A_T = \frac{P(A \to B) - P(B \to A)}{P(A \to B) + P(B \to A)} \neq 0
interpretation: Quantifies the microscopic arrow of time as the normalized difference between the transition probability of a process and its time-reversed counterpart.
symmetry_origin: The presence of a complex phase in the CKM or PMNS matrices which cannot be removed by coordinate rotations.
limits_and_boundary: Provides the direct observational proof for T-violation in neutral meson systems, distinguishing the past from the future at the subatomic scale.
